# {{ site.data.profile.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.data.profile.role }}. This is a personal research portfolio. Where to stimulate is work in progress. When covers event detection and seizure prediction. How covers biohybrid circuits and the design or generation of stimulation patterns, including synthetic neural time series.

The bibliography is selected, with journal articles, conference papers and conference abstracts labelled separately. The interactive figures are conceptual illustrations. The Kuramoto demonstration uses model-generated signals; the research map's height and distance are not scientific measurements.

- [Research overview and selected publications in Markdown]({{ '/index.md' | absolute_url }}): Research questions, study summaries, complete selected citations, DOI links and available data links, generated from the portfolio's current content.
- [Interactive portfolio]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): The visual website, including the reconstruction and stimulation illustration.
- [Publications]({{ '/#publications' | absolute_url }}): The selected bibliography in HTML.
